title: A novel PEX14/PEX5 interface links peroxisomal protein import and receptor recycling
authors: Emmanouilidis L; Sehr J; Reglinski K; Gaussmann S; Goricanec D; Kordon J; Menezes F; Waithe D; Hublitz P; Bader V; Winklhofer KF; Jung M; Schliebs W; Eggeling C; Erdmann R; Sattler M
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过NMR和生化方法解析PEX14无序区IPSWQI肽段与PEX5 TPR结构域的新结合界面，揭示其调控过氧化物酶体蛋白输入与受体循环的机制，虽无AI/物理模拟方法，但聚焦IDR介导的PPI机制建模，对本课题有直接参考价值。
abstract: Newly synthesized peroxisomal proteins are recognized in the cytosol by the cycling receptor PEX5 and directed to a docking complex comprising PEX14 and PEX13 at the peroxisomal membrane. After cargo translocation, the unloaded PEX5 is recycled in an ATP-dependent manner. Receptor docking involves the WxxxF-motifs in the N-terminal domain (NTD) of PEX5 that are recognized by the N-terminal domain of PEX14. Here, we combine biochemical methods and NMR spectroscopy to identify a novel binding interface between human PEX5 and PEX14. The interaction involves the PEX5 C-terminal cargo-binding TPR domain and a conserved IPSWQI peptide motif in the C-terminal intrinsically disordered region of PEX14. The three-dimensional structure of the PEX14 IPSWQI peptide bound the PEX5 TPR domain, shows the PEX14 interaction is non-overlapping with PTS1 binding to the TPR domain. Notably, PEX14 IPSWQI motif binding to a hinge region in the TPR domain shows a more open supercoil of the TPR fold that resembles the apo conformation in the absence of PTS1 peptide. Mutation of binding site residues in PEX5 or PEX14 leads to a partial protein import defect and decrease of the steady-state-concentration of PEX5. This resembles the mutant phenotype of cells affected in receptor recycling, suggesting a role in this process.
abstract_zh: 新合成的过氧化物酶体蛋白在细胞质中被循环受体PEX5识别，并被引导至过氧化物酶体膜上包含PEX14和PEX13的对接复合体。货物转运后，未负载的PEX5以ATP依赖的方式被回收。受体对接涉及PEX5 N端结构域（NTD）中的WxxxF基序，这些基序被PEX14的N端结构域识别。在此，我们结合生物化学方法和核磁共振波谱（NMR spectroscopy）来鉴定人类PEX5与PEX14之间的新型结合界面。该相互作用涉及PEX5 C端货物结合TPR结构域和PEX14 C端内在无序区域中一个保守的IPSWQI肽基序。PEX14 IPSWQI肽结合PEX5 TPR结构域的三维结构显示，PEX14的相互作用与PTS1结合TPR结构域不重叠。值得注意的是，PEX14 IPSWQI基序结合TPR结构域中的铰链区，显示出TPR折叠更开放的超螺旋构象，类似于无PTS1肽时的脱辅基构象。PEX5或PEX14中结合位点残基的突变导致部分蛋白质导入缺陷和PEX5稳态浓度降低。这类似于受体回收受影响细胞的突变表型，提示其在该过程中发挥作用。
